textRuns.value: 1) Each value in source or target field defines the relevant node.
2) Each unique pair of source and target values defines the links between nodes.
3) Weight field defines thickness of relevant nodes.
4) LinkType field can define color of the link and text of the link label.
5) Image source directory url and image extension can be changed using formatting pane.
6) Source type and target type fields can define image names of relevant nodes.
7) Both source and target field are required.
8) Color, text size and maximum length of data labels can be changed using formatting pane.
9) There are options to show or hide arrows that represents the direction of the link.
10) Type of the node color definition can be changed using formatting pane.
11) There are options to show or hide labels of the link type and to enable or disable thikness of nodes.
12) There are options to show or hide the image of the node and to set the default image name.
13) There are options to enable or disable highlighting of all reachable links.
14) The charge of nodes that defines distance therebetween can be changed using formatting pane. It must be negative but greater than -100.
15) If inveractive mode is enabled then hovering on a node point highlights reachable links.
16) Clicking on a node and dragging it can change a layout of nodes.
